tagline.zh: 让产品数据自己讲清楚
tagline.en: Let your product data speak clearly

summary.zh: Aether 是一个面向产品团队的轻量数据展示工具，把分散的指标、更新和来源整理成一页可核验的事实。
summary.en: Aether is a lightweight data presentation tool for product teams, turning scattered metrics, updates, and sources into one verifiable page.

bio.zh: 示例团队信息：请替换为真实作者或团队介绍。
bio.en: Example team bio: replace with the real author or team introduction.

summary.zh: 数据页现在为每项指标显示统计口径和来源链接。
summary.en: The data page now shows methodology and source links for each metric.

title.zh: 上线英文站与主题切换
title.en: Launched English site and theme switcher

summary.zh: 站点支持中英文、深浅主题与跟随系统。
summary.en: The site supports Chinese/English, dark/light themes, and system preference.

description.zh: 数据页维护完整事实，落地页只做派生摘要，避免口径漂移。
description.en: The data page keeps full facts while the landing page derives summaries to prevent drift.

description.zh: 每项指标带时间、单位与来源链接，读者能自行查证。
description.en: Every metric carries time, unit, and source link so readers can verify it.

description.zh: 静态输出、按需交互与缓存策略让首屏保持快速。
description.en: Static output, selective interactivity, and cache rules keep the first screen fast.

disclaimer.zh: 示例免责声明：本站数据用于产品说明，不构成投资、采购或法律建议；实际信息以来源链接和更新日期为准。
